name: How does a punch list impact final payment for a construction project?

mainEntity.name: How does a punch list impact final payment for a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final payment for a construction project is typically contingent upon the substantial completion of the work and the satisfactory resolution of all punch list items. A retainer or a portion of the final payment may be withheld until all listed deficiencies are addressed. For Maine Results, Inc., clearing the punch list is a critical step to ensure client satisfaction and prompt final payment, reflecting completed project quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Final payment is often withheld until all punch list items are satisfactorily resolved.
